summary: The candidate adds administrator-authenticated signing-key rotation and emergency retirement, bounded JWKS overlap, atomic audit records, documentation and tests; no introduced defect was found.

evidence: `src/passport.ts` exposes POST `.../signing-key/rotate` and `.../signing-key/emergency-retire` plus an audit GET, all gated by `requireAdminUser` and exact origin plus CSRF for mutations.

`src/auth_store.ts` `replaceSigningKeyRecord` atomically checks the current key, swaps `signing/current`, writes a `SigningKeyAuditRecord`, retains the old public key for `overlapMs`, and deletes retired keys on emergency.

`src/token_service.ts` uses `accessTokenMaxTtlMs` as the overlap and re-reads the active key after signing, retrying so issuance switches away from the old `kid`; JWKS and verification accept retired keys only while live.
`tests/passport_cutover_test.ts` and `README.md` document and test normal rotation, JWKS refresh, continued old-token verification during overlap, and emergency replacement rejecting old tokens.
